page.overview:
What is Prince Charming?

Prince Charming is the tenth song from the 1997 album ReLoad. It was written by James Hetfield and Lars Ulrich, and has a length of 6:03. It doesn't appear in any official release.

Prince Charming is about alienation, self-loathing, addiction, and societal rejection through the persona of an outcast. While the title of Prince Charming isn't sung in the song, it is used ironically to demonstrate that the narrator is the polar opposite of what's expected, yet seeking validation.

"Prince Charming" has never been performed live.

There's a black cloud overhead That's me And the poison ivy chokes the tree Again it's me I'm the filthy one on Bourbon Street you walk on by I'm the little boy that pushes hard and makes it cry
